live.note: Live evidence can only lower a verdict: a 'better' cell becomes a tie when 100+ graded live games or bets score against it (t <= -2). NHL and NBA opener cells stay provisional until 50 graded at fresh US-book openers Locksmith's line poller saw are not significantly worse than the backtest (z > -1.64); significantly worse turns them into a tie. The scorecard's record at the opener counts only games scored at the first line a real US sportsbook posted, as Locksmith's line poller captured it; games at other openers (Action Network's 'Open', the college / NFL feeds') are listed in each cell's live.left_out, never mixed in.

method.metric: log loss for chances, average absolute miss in points for margins and totals; gain = market loss - Locksmith loss
method.t: mean gain / standard error clustered by date
method.rule: better = Python and R both better (interval > 0, t >= 2, >= 60% of seasons), clean information set, today's opener source tested, live record not against; worse = interval < 0; else tie
method.marginal: a rule picked from a search whose betting t is within 0.25 of its corrected bar (one-sided 5% Bonferroni over every variant tried), or whose accuracy t is under that bar: still better, stake capped
method.provisional: NHL / NBA opener cells measured against Action Network's 'Open' line: confirmed after 50 graded at capture-verified fresh US-book openers (data/certify/_opener_live.json)
